finalists.label: Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma and pan-cytokeratin (AE1/3) immunostain positive.

finalists.label: Hidradenoma
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma and p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers.

frontier_selector.why: Syringocystadenoma Papilliferum is chosen due to its strong for evidence, including tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections and pan-cytokeratin (AE1/3) immunostain positive, which are specific to this diagnosis.
